title: Keep operational task workflows planning-blind
description: Audit and harden every existing execution query after the unified loader is introduced. task list/show/ready/next/start, stats overview/focused/series, graph, handoffs, and batch export/import must return or mutate executable tasks only. Planning records may participate solely in global dependency validation and blocked-reason calculation; a blocker should identify its planning short ID, title, and status without making it claimable or graph-expanded. Add regression tests for matching IDs/status names, planning-only stores, cross-lifecycle blockers, stats totals, batch all/status selection, graph internal edges, and concurrent next claims.
